correctness.rationale: For c != 0, conjugation and row permutation reduce to c=1. In the orthonormal multiplicative-character basis, A is a 2x2 block B plus character permutation weighted by L_chi. For chi=eta, L_eta=-i sin theta+(1-cos theta)eta(-1) has exact modulus 2sin(pi/p). For all other nontrivial chi, the Jacobi sum has magnitude sqrt(p), giving a strict gap. The positive determinant (p-1)(p-3)(1-C)^2(1+2C) and positive trace of B*B-m²I rule out a block tie. Lower bounds on sigma_+(B) dominate every character sector, with explicit p=5 check. The largest block eigenvalue yields exact condition number and its p²/(2pi)+O(1) expansion. Supplementary 140 numerical assertions passed.
